def daily(day):
    # cumulative; usage = last hour of day - last hour of prev day
    end=day+"T23:00:00"
    # find previous timestamp (should be prev day 23:00 if data full, else fallback)
    # just get 23:00 of prev day
    import datetime
    d=datetime.datetime.strptime(day,"%Y-%m-%d")
    prev=(d-datetime.timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    start=prev+"T23:00:00"
    endv=data[end]; startv=data[start]
    return endv-startv, endv, startv

d0126, e2, s2 = daily("2018-01-26")
print("2018-10-21 J:", d1021, "  = kWh:", d1021/3.6e6)
print("2018-01-26 J:", d0126, "  = kWh:", d0126/3.6e6)
print("10-21 > 01-26 ?", d1021>d0126)

def daily_sum(day):
    import datetime
    d=datetime.datetime.strptime(day,"%Y-%m-%d")
    tot=0
    for h in range(24):
        tt=day+f"T{h:02d}:00:00"
        tot+=data[tt]
    return tot

t1=daily_sum("2018-10-21")
t2=daily_sum("2018-01-26")
print("2018-10-21 total J:",t1,"=kWh",t1/3.6e6)
print("2018-01-26 total J:",t2,"=kWh",t2/3.6e6)
print("10-21 > 01-26 ?", t1>t2)
